hypothesis: A fresh, depth-one bare snapshot of the pinned MLX-LM baseline commit can materialize a clean worktree whose Python source inventory and bytes satisfy the existing v9 source manifest, without using the caller repository checkout metadata.
method: Fetch the exact commit from the public upstream remote into a new bare repository with depth one and no tags or submodules.
Pass that bare repository to the v12 source snapshot helper, which fetches only the same exact commit into second fresh bare metadata.
Create one detached worktree from the second bare repository under the sanitized Git environment.
Run the existing read-only verify_pinned_source_tree check and compare the target-file hash and Python inventory to frozen v9 inputs.
no_go_claims: No candidate patch grading or task certification.
No model loading, inference, training, or optimizer update.
No held-out evaluation or capability claim.
primary_outcome: Pass only if commit identity, clean worktree state, complete Python inventory, and all manifest file hashes verify; otherwise retain the failing record and stop.
stop_conditions: Either Git fetch exceeds its 180-second command timeout.
Total temporary bare repository object storage exceeds 512 MiB.
Swap use grows by more than 256 MiB from the preflight reading.
The fetched commit, target-file hash, source manifest, clean-worktree check, or full inventory differs.

task.exposure_classification: consumed-development-only; no model exposure or split change
